prompt: This photorealistic photo captures a bustling hospital corridor. On the left stands a nurse in blue scrubs holding a clipboard. Next to her sits an elderly woman in a floral dress on a metal bench. A young boy in a striped shirt points at a colorful poster on the wall near the center. Beside the boy, a brown dog wears a service vest and looks up attentively. In the center foreground, a doctor in a white coat hands a prescription to a man in a red scarf. The man in the red scarf looks at the paper with concern. To the right, a janitor in gray overalls pushes a yellow mop bucket past a potted fern. Behind the janitor, a security guard in a black uniform leans against the wall with arms crossed. Above them, a digital clock displays the time in bright red numbers. Near the ceiling on the right, a smoke detector is mounted on the white tiles. There is no blood visible anywhere in the scene. There is no sunlight streaming through windows, only artificial overhead lighting.
